newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian Air says creditors to back revamp.
newsitem.headline: Canadian Air says creditors to back revamp.

text.p: Canadian Airlines Corp said on Wednesday that it expected all its creditors to agree to its restructuring plan by June 30.
"We do not believe that there is anybody who will not be signing. The deal-breaking type issues are over," Chief Executive Kevin Benson told reporters after the airline's annual meeting.

Troubled Canadian unveiled its financial restructuring last November in hopes of averting bankruptcy. It implemented route changes, won wage cuts from employees and asked creditors to accept payment deferrals.
"The suspension of payments of C$170 million out of C$265 million due over a six-month period is providing a cash bridge until the benefits of the plan are realized," Canadian said earlier.
It said three-quarters of its creditors had signed the plan so far and the rest were expected to do so shortly.
